consent.title: Talk with Céoù
consent.body: To hold a real conversation, your voice is streamed live to Gemini, Google’s artificial intelligence service, outside the European Union. As the conversation goes, Céoù also passes it the results of your searches — item names and where they are stored — but never your whole inventory. Nothing is sent until the conversation is open. When it is unavailable, the simple assistant takes over: only the text of your sentence is sent then.

demarrer.title: Getting started
demarrer.summary: Add an item and learn how to find it.
demarrer.goal: Save your first item and its storage location.
steps: In Places, tap Add to create your home.
Open it and add a room. For a car or garage, go straight to storage.
Add storage, such as a cupboard or shelf, and a box if needed.
Add your item. A photo helps you recognise it but is optional.
Search for its name in Find, then open its details.
demarrer.tip: Start with things you often look for. The cable drawer can wait.
demarrer.result: The item details show each level of its storage path.
demarrer.action_hint: The guide helps you add a real item to your inventory.

factures.title: Your receipts and warranties
factures.goal: Keep proof of purchase alongside your items.
steps: Open an item page and tap “Add a receipt”.
Photograph the till receipt — or import the PDF the shop emailed you.
Note the seller, the purchase date, the amount, and the warranty end date if the item has one.
One receipt can cover several items. Open it from the home’s Receipts screen and add them: each keeps its own amount and warranty.
From another item page, choose “One already saved” to attach it to the same receipt without photographing the paper again.
The “Without receipt” tab lists everything with no proof yet. The export button, at the top, builds the complete file.
factures.tip: Add the warranty end date to receive the reminder scheduled 30 days before it expires.
factures.result: Export a PDF of your supporting documents from the home’s invoices.

retrouver.title: Finding a belonging
retrouver.summary: By searching, or by asking out loud.
retrouver.goal: Find an item without searching every cupboard.
steps: In Find, enter the item’s name. Use Filters to choose a place or room.
Open a result to see its full storage path.
To speak, tap Ask Céoù at the bottom and ask “Where are my scissors?”.
You can also ask to store an item. Check the result and clarify the item or storage if Céoù asks.
Say “That’s all” or close the window when finished. It also closes after 20 seconds without a reply.
retrouver.tip: Be specific when items share a name: “the kitchen scissors”, for example.
retrouver.result: Find the storage location and open its plan from the item details, if one exists.

ajouter-vite.title: Adding many items
ajouter-vite.summary: Scan a photo or a barcode instead of typing everything.
ajouter-vite.goal: Add several items from a photo.
steps: From a storage location, open the add-item menu and choose Scan a photo.
Take a clear picture of the shelf or open drawer.
Check the suggested items, correct names and uncheck anything to ignore.
Confirm your selection. For a labelled product, you can also scan its barcode.
If the product is unknown, complete its details yourself.
ajouter-vite.tip: Recognition can make mistakes. A quick check avoids adding the scenery to your inventory.
ajouter-vite.result: Your selected items are added to the storage location.

plan.title: Your home’s floor plan
plan.summary: Explore rooms and locate your items.
plan.goal: See which room and storage to look in.
steps: In Places, open your home, then Plans. Open a plan or add one; a template can help you get started.
Tap a room to zoom in. Its numbered storage locations appear in the list below.
Tap Edit to draw or move rooms and storage, then Done when finished.
From an item’s details, tap View on plan. Its room is framed and placed storage gets a larger numbered marker.
The card below shows the item and its path. Close it to explore other rooms.
plan.tip: If storage is not placed on the plan, Céoù highlights the room. List view also lets you read the plan without using the drawing.
plan.result: The same number connects the storage marker to your item’s card.

prets.title: Lending and borrowing
prets.summary: Remember what left your home, and what you owe back.
prets.goal: Remember who has your things and what you need to return.
steps: On an item page, tap “Lend or borrow”.
Say which way it goes: you are lending it, or you borrowed it.
Pick a friend from the list, or simply type a name — the person does not need to have Céoù.
Set a return date if you have one: Céoù will remind you on the day. Without a date, the loan stays in the list until you close it.
When the item comes back, a button on its page or in the Loans screen closes the loan.
prets.tip: The drill hasn’t vanished. Its details tell you who borrowed it.
prets.result: Loans stay available until you close them.

amis.title: Sharing with people close to you
amis.summary: Give access to a home, and choose how far it goes.
amis.goal: Share an inventory with people you know.
steps: In Profile, open Friends and invitations to find your friend code.
Your friend enters it or scans its QR from Sharing, then Add a friend.
Accept the request. Becoming friends does not share any places.
Open their details and choose permissions for each home: view, edit or owner.
Change these permissions whenever needed.
amis.tip: Permissions apply to each place. Sharing the house doesn’t mean sharing the garage.
amis.result: Your friend can access only the places you shared.

invites.title: Access with no account
invites.summary: A read-only code for a tenant, a tradesperson, a house-sitter.
invites.goal: Give someone view-only access without creating an account.
steps: In Profile → Friends and invitations, tap Generate an access code.
Choose the homes they can view.
Set the duration and number of uses.
Name the code so you can recognise it, for example September guests.
Share the link or code. Your guest chooses I have an invitation code to enter.
invites.tip: Manage or revoke access under My invitation codes in the same section.
invites.result: Guests can view authorised places without changing the inventory.

affichage.title: Adjusting the display
affichage.goal: Choose a display that feels comfortable.
steps: In Profile, open My preferences.
Choose Français or English for the language.
Turn dark mode on or off, or let Céoù follow your phone.
Choose a text size and check the preview. It applies straight away.
affichage.tip: Your phone’s text size settings are also taken into account.
affichage.result: Text and controls adapt throughout the app.

hors-ligne.title: With no network
hors-ligne.summary: What Céoù can do in a cellar or a garage.
hors-ligne.goal: Keep organising when the signal drops.
steps: Open Céoù while connected before you leave: available data is kept on your phone.
Offline, browse your inventory and add, rename or move items.
Pending changes are sent when the connection returns.
If a change is rejected, use the banner to review it or try again.
hors-ligne.tip: Voice, photo recognition, barcode product lookup and invoice export need a connection.
hors-ligne.result: Local changes wait for a connection before syncing.

demenagement.title: Plan a move
demenagement.summary: Find your things among the boxes.
demenagement.goal: Track boxes from packing to unpacking.
steps: In Places, open Organise a move and create your move.
Choose the starting place and destination.
Create a box, add a photo and pack your items into it.
Use the actions to scan a box or print labels. Follow progress at the top of the screen.
On arrival, switch to unpacking and choose where to put each item.
demenagement.tip: Your move stays private until you choose Share with friends. Permissions follow the homes involved.
demenagement.result: Each box keeps its list of items. Handy when you need that charger on the first night.
